reviews.title: No trial period
reviews.text:
I think apps that try to catch an impulse buy and have me spend my money before I have the opportunity to try the app and see if it’s going to work for me only in it for my money. And that that’s why I gave it one star.
I understand that everybody needs to make a profit, but I need to see if something’s going to work for me before I invest my money.

reviews.title: Forced to suscribe
reviews.text: It was all alright till it forced me to suscribe.

reviews.title: Ads despite premium
reviews.text: Despite being a premium member, I now have to click through an AppLife subscription ad every time I want to just quickly log a habit

reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text:
I bought this app about 4 years ago to keep track of new habits I need for my health and wellness. I’ve noticed in the last few months, or maybe longer since I never really looked, that one of my habits is almost always not kept accurately. The last entry of the day and sometimes more are missing. It happens to other habits occasionally, but one in particular.

I use iCloud to sync the app between my iphone, iPad and Apple Watch. Even if I only use one device to make all of the entries, it isn’t kept correctly. Even if I go back and correct the entries until they match on both my iPhone and iPad, they are wrong again by the next day.

I’ve contacted support and received no response. I would appreciate it if this bug was squashed or I was contacted as to how I can correct it in my case.

reviews.title: Disappointed with Money Grab Tactics
reviews.text: I’ve had the premium version for a couple years, all of a sudden I can’t use the additional habits I created and have been using without purchasing a $14.99 upgrade. In addition to that it blocked the ability for me to go back to previous days, update and/or add notes I feel like it’s a strong arm tactic to squeeze more money out of users. I canceled because of the principal. I am very disappointed with this money grab tactic. I was a loyal user but now, I’ll be going elsewhere.

reviews.title: Everything great until forced subscription
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for YEARS, and this morning I went to go track my time for 15 minutes of reading, only to be met with needing to pay $15 a year to use my “Reading” habit. This app was a daily part of my life. I was disappointed that updates caused the widget not to work properly (you used to be able to click the habit on the widget to open straight to the that part of the app). But, now that a faithful user of over 5 years is being forced to pay a premium for the EXACT SAME THING I used yesterday and every day for years… I’m deleting this app and looking elsewhere.

reviews.title: App Misleading
reviews.text: previously paid for the app. Now, after the update, they want me to subscribe for $20 a year. What a rip off.

reviews.title: iWatch app Crashes Immediately
reviews.text: Loved the app for years, but the iWatch app will not open and crashes. I am a premium subscriber and can not use the app on my iWatch.

reviews.title: Bait & Switch
reviews.text:
I was not going to continue premium & discontinued. Happy with the app, but couldn’t afford the continued cost.
Then a “special” came up on the screen to renew for 90% discount= $5.99 annually. Then it charged me full price. I have reached out to the app & Apple with zero responses. I have photos to prove what I am saying as facts. NOT HAPPY at all. How many others fell for misleading and misrepresentation with NO recourse?!
